schema.text: Select the uses that apply to you. For each selected use, tell us how often and what would let you leave the car. If none apply, select None of these.

columns.label: What would let you leave the car for this?

options.label: More frequent and reliable public transport, also in the evening
An accompanied or on-demand transport service

en.#What would let you leave the car for th: What would let you leave the car for this?
en.#More frequent and reliable public trans: More frequent and reliable public transport, also in the evening
en.#An accompanied or on-demand transport s: An accompanied or on-demand transport service
en.#Select the uses that apply to you. For: Select the uses that apply to you. For each selected use, tell us how often and what would let you leave the car. If none apply, select None of these.

it.#What would let you leave the car for th: Cosa ti permetterebbe di lasciare l’auto per questo uso?
it.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Un trasporto pubblico più frequente e affidabile, anche di sera
it.#An accompanied or on-demand transport s: Un servizio di accompagnamento o di trasporto a chiamata
it.#Select the uses that apply to you. For: Seleziona gli usi che ti riguardano. Per ogni uso selezionato, indica quanto spesso e cosa ti permetterebbe di lasciare l’auto. Se nessuno ti riguarda, seleziona Nessuna di queste.

fr.#What would let you leave the car for th: Qu’est-ce qui vous permettrait de laisser la voiture pour cet usage ?
fr.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Des transports en commun plus fréquents et plus fiables, y compris le soir
fr.#An accompanied or on-demand transport s: Un service de transport accompagné ou à la demande
fr.#Select the uses that apply to you. For: Sélectionnez les usages qui vous concernent. Pour chaque usage sélectionné, indiquez à quelle fréquence et ce qui vous permettrait de laisser la voiture. Si aucun ne vous concerne, sélectionnez Aucun de ces éléments.

de.#What would let you leave the car for th: Was würde es Ihnen ermöglichen, das Auto dafür stehen zu lassen?
de.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Häufigere und zuverlässigere öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, auch am Abend
de.#An accompanied or on-demand transport s: Ein begleiteter Fahrdienst oder ein Fahrdienst auf Abruf
de.#Select the uses that apply to you. For: Wählen Sie die Nutzungen aus, die auf Sie zutreffen. Geben Sie für jede ausgewählte Nutzung an, wie oft und was es Ihnen ermöglichen würde, das Auto stehen zu lassen. Wenn keine zutrifft, wählen Sie Keine davon.

tr.#What would let you leave the car for th: Bu amaç için arabayı kullanmamanızı ne sağlar?
tr.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Akşamları da dahil olmak üzere daha sık ve güvenilir toplu taşıma
tr.#An accompanied or on-demand transport s: Refakatli veya talep üzerine ulaşım hizmeti
tr.#Select the uses that apply to you. For: Size uygun kullanım amaçlarını seçin. Seçtiğiniz her amaç için ne sıklıkta olduğunu ve arabayı kullanmamanızı neyin sağlayacağını belirtin. Hiçbiri size uygun değilse Bunların hiçbiri seçeneğini seçin.

fa.#What would let you leave the car for th: چه چیزی به شما امکان می‌دهد برای این کار از خودرو استفاده نکنید؟
fa.#More frequent and reliable public trans: حمل‌ونقل عمومی پرتکرارتر و قابل‌اعتمادتر، حتی در عصر و شب
fa.#An accompanied or on-demand transport s: خدمات حمل‌ونقل همراه با کمک یا بنا به درخواست
fa.#Select the uses that apply to you. For: موارد استفاده‌ای را که درباره شما صدق می‌کند انتخاب کنید. برای هر مورد انتخاب‌شده، بگویید چند وقت یک‌بار و چه چیزی به شما امکان می‌دهد از خودرو استفاده نکنید. اگر هیچ‌کدام صدق نمی‌کند، گزینه هیچ‌کدام از این موارد را انتخاب کنید.

hu.#What would let you leave the car for th: Mi tenné lehetővé, hogy ehhez ne használjon autót?
hu.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Gyakoribb és megbízhatóbb tömegközlekedés, este is
hu.#An accompanied or on-demand transport s: Kísérővel biztosított vagy igény szerinti közlekedési szolgáltatás
hu.#Select the uses that apply to you. For: Válassza ki az Önre vonatkozó felhasználási célokat. Minden kiválasztott célnál adja meg, milyen gyakran fordul elő, és mi tenné lehetővé, hogy ne autóval menjen. Ha egyik sem vonatkozik Önre, válassza az Egyik sem lehetőséget.

ar.#What would let you leave the car for th: ما الذي يتيح لك الاستغناء عن السيارة لهذا الاستخدام؟
ar.#More frequent and reliable public trans: نقل عام أكثر تواترًا وموثوقية، حتى في المساء
ar.#An accompanied or on-demand transport s: خدمة نقل مع مرافقة أو حسب الطلب
ar.#Select the uses that apply to you. For: يُرجى اختيار الاستخدامات التي تنطبق عليك. لكل استخدام تختاره، حدّد مدى تكراره وما الذي يتيح لك الاستغناء عن السيارة. إذا لم ينطبق أيّ منها، يُرجى اختيار لا شيء مما سبق.
